card.name: The letter t starting medical words
card.fires_on: A lone "t" or "T" piece that begins a medical word, such as tinnitus, tachycardia, tachypnea or tenth, often after a comma in a symptom list. It also fires on "ot" inside words like phenotyped and pseudotumor.

modes.label: t starting symptom words
modes.description: A separate "t" piece opens a symptom term after a comma in a list of toxicity signs.

modes.label: tenth in fractions
modes.description: The "t" after "one-" that begins "tenth" in a dose fraction.
modes.example: the starting dose is one<<-t>>enth times the desmopressin

modes.label: ot inside long words
modes.description: The piece "ot" in the middle of a long medical word.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuations like "est" and "en", which fit words such as tenth and testing.
card.plain: It spots a stray "t" that starts a medical word, like tachycardia or tenth, so the model can finish the word.
